use super::*;
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine};
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::TcpListener;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

// Public test vector from minisign-verify 0.2.5 (MIT), src/lib.rs verify_prehashed.
// No private key exists here and no release signing key is generated by these tests.
const PUBLIC_KEY: &str = "untrusted comment: minisign public key E7620F1842B4E81F\nRWQf6LRCGA9i53mlYecO4IzT51TGPpvWucNSCh1CBM0QTaLn73Y7GFO3";
const SIGNATURE: &str = "untrusted comment: signature from minisign secret key\nRUQf6LRCGA9i559r3g7V1qNyJDApGip8MfqcadIgT9CuhV3EMhHoN1mGTkUidF/z7SrlQgXdy8ofjb7bNJJylDOocrCo8KLzZwo=\ntrusted comment: timestamp:1556193335\tfile:test\ny/rUw2y8/hOUYjZU71eHp/Wo1KZ40fGy2VJEDl34XMJM+TX48Ss/17u3IvIfbVR1FkZZSNCisQbuQY+bHwhEBg==";

struct FixtureServer {
    url: tauri::Url,
    stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}
impl Drop for FixtureServer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
            thread.join().unwrap();
        }
    }
}
fn serve(
    payload: &[u8],
    signature: &str,
    status: u16,
    declared_size: Option<u64>,
) -> FixtureServer {
    serve_with_check(payload, signature, status, declared_size, None)
}
fn serve_with_check(
    payload: &[u8],
    signature: &str,
    status: u16,
    declared_size: Option<u64>,
    check: Option<(u16, String, Duration)>,
) -> FixtureServer {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
    let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let url = tauri::Url::parse(&format!("http://{address}/check")).unwrap();
    let manifest = serde_json::json!({
        "version": "2.0.0-beta.2", "notes": "Signed local fixture; never installed",
        "url": format!("http://{address}/payload"), "signature": STANDARD.encode(signature)
    })
    .to_string();
    let (check_status, manifest, delay) = check.unwrap_or((200, manifest, Duration::ZERO));
    let payload = payload.to_vec();
    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let stopping = stop.clone();
    let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        while !stopping.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            let Ok((mut stream, _)) = listener.accept() else {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
                continue;
            };
            stream
                .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
                .unwrap();
            let mut request = [0; 2048];
            let count = stream.read(&mut request).unwrap_or(0);
            let artifact = String::from_utf8_lossy(&request[..count]).starts_with("GET /payload ");
            let body = if artifact {
                payload.as_slice()
            } else {
                manifest.as_bytes()
            };
            if !artifact {
                std::thread::sleep(delay);
            }
            let response_status = if artifact { status } else { check_status };
            let size = if artifact {
                declared_size.unwrap_or(body.len() as u64)
            } else {
                body.len() as u64
            };
            let _ = write!(stream, "HTTP/1.1 {response_status} OK\r\nContent-Length: {size}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n");
            let _ = stream.write_all(body);
        }
    });
    FixtureServer {
        url,
        stop,
        thread: Some(thread),
    }
}

fn test_app() -> tauri::App<tauri::test::MockRuntime> {
    let mut context = tauri::test::mock_context(tauri::test::noop_assets());
    context.config_mut().plugins.0.insert(
        "updater".into(),
        serde_json::json!({"pubkey":"", "endpoints":[]}),
    );
    let app = tauri::test::mock_builder()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
        .build(context)
        .unwrap();
    app
}

async fn candidate(
    server: &FixtureServer,
    public_key: &str,
) -> (tauri::App<tauri::test::MockRuntime>, Update) {
    let app = test_app();
    let updater = app
        .handle()
        .updater_builder()
        .endpoints(vec![server.url.clone()])
        .unwrap()
        .pubkey(STANDARD.encode(public_key))
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
        .no_proxy()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    let update = updater.check().await.unwrap().unwrap();
    (app, update)
}

#[test]
fn absent_channel_is_unavailable_and_partial_or_insecure_configuration_is_rejected() {
    let empty: ReleaseChannel = serde_json::from_str(CHANNEL_CONFIG).unwrap();
    assert!(!empty.configured().unwrap());
    for endpoints in [
        vec![],
        vec!["http://example.test/update".into()],
        vec!["https://user:pass@example.test/update".into()],
    ] {
        let config = ReleaseChannel {
            channel: "beta".into(),
            endpoints,
            public_key: Some("fixture".into()),
        };
        assert!(config.configured().is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn semver_update_policy_never_downgrades_or_sends_a_beta_to_stable_users() {
    for (current, next, channel, expected) in [
        ("2.0.0-beta.1", "2.0.0-beta.2", "beta", true),
        ("2.0.0-beta.2", "2.0.0-beta.10", "beta", true),
        ("2.0.0-beta.10", "2.0.0-beta.2", "beta", false),
        ("2.0.0-beta.2", "2.0.0", "beta", true),
        ("2.0.0", "2.1.0-beta.1", "stable", false),
        ("2.0.0", "2.0.0", "stable", false),
        ("2.0.0", "1.9.9", "beta", false),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(
            newer_version(&current.parse().unwrap(), &next.parse().unwrap(), channel),
            expected
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn real_updater_download_accepts_the_published_signed_vector_and_reports_verification() {
    let server = serve(b"test", SIGNATURE, 200, None);
    let (_app, update) = candidate(&server, PUBLIC_KEY).await;
    let (_abort, receiver) = watch::channel(false);
    let events = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
    let bytes = verified_download(&update, receiver, |event| {
        events.lock().unwrap().push(event)
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(bytes, b"test");
    let events = events.lock().unwrap();
    assert!(events.iter().any(|event| event.received == 4));
    assert_eq!(events.last().unwrap().phase, "verifying");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn modified_bytes_invalid_signature_and_wrong_public_key_fail_real_verification() {
    for (payload, signature, key) in [
        (&b"tesT"[..], SIGNATURE.to_owned(), PUBLIC_KEY.to_owned()),
        (
            &b"test"[..],
            SIGNATURE.replace("RUQf6", "RUQe6"),
            PUBLIC_KEY.to_owned(),
        ),
        (
            &b"test"[..],
            SIGNATURE.to_owned(),
            PUBLIC_KEY.replace("GA9i53", "GA9i54"),
        ),
    ] {
        let server = serve(payload, &signature, 200, None);
        let (_app, update) = candidate(&server, &key).await;
        let (_abort, receiver) = watch::channel(false);
        let result = verified_download(&update, receiver, |_| {}).await;
        assert!(result.is_err(), "must reject modified signed material");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn http_failure_truncation_oversize_and_cancellation_never_return_installable_bytes() {
    for (status, size) in [
        (503, None),
        (200, Some(100)),
        (200, Some(MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES + 1)),
    ] {
        let server = serve(b"test", SIGNATURE, status, size);
        let (_app, update) = candidate(&server, PUBLIC_KEY).await;
        let (_abort, receiver) = watch::channel(false);
        assert!(verified_download(&update, receiver, |_| {}).await.is_err());
    }
    let server = serve(b"test", SIGNATURE, 200, None);
    let (_app, update) = candidate(&server, PUBLIC_KEY).await;
    let (abort, receiver) = watch::channel(false);
    abort.send(true).unwrap();
    assert!(verified_download(&update, receiver, |_| {})
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("取消"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn real_manifest_check_handles_no_update_bad_metadata_http_errors_and_timeout() {
    for (status, body, delay, no_update) in [
        (204, "", Duration::ZERO, true),
        (200, "not JSON", Duration::ZERO, false),
        (
            200,
            r#"{"version":"2.0.1","url":"https://example.test/package"}"#,
            Duration::ZERO,
            false,
        ),
        (503, "unavailable", Duration::ZERO, false),
        (200, "{}", Duration::from_millis(200), false),
    ] {
        let server = serve_with_check(
            b"test",
            SIGNATURE,
            200,
            None,
            Some((status, body.into(), delay)),
        );
        let app = test_app();
        let updater = app
            .updater_builder()
            .endpoints(vec![server.url.clone()])
            .unwrap()
            .pubkey(STANDARD.encode(PUBLIC_KEY))
            .timeout(Duration::from_millis(100))
            .no_proxy()
            .build()
            .unwrap();
        let result = updater.check().await;
        if no_update {
            assert!(result.unwrap().is_none());
        } else {
            assert!(
                result.is_err(),
                "invalid/incomplete metadata must not offer an update"
            );
        }
    }
    let server = serve(b"test", SIGNATURE, 200, None);
    let url = server.url.clone();
    drop(server);
    let app = test_app();
    let updater = app
        .updater_builder()
        .endpoints(vec![url])
        .unwrap()
        .pubkey(STANDARD.encode(PUBLIC_KEY))
        .timeout(Duration::from_millis(100))
        .no_proxy()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(
        updater.check().await.is_err(),
        "offline endpoint must not claim latest version"
    );
}
